title: ReinjectionFrame
description: Minimal context recompilation frame. rho and theta are control allocations with the semantic invariant rho + theta = 1; JSON Schema alone does not enforce the sum constraint.

delta_refs.description: Changed payload references eligible for this cycle.

persistent_refs.description: Addresses of unchanged slow/static state. Their payloads are not implicitly replayed.

revived_refs.description: Previously shadowed or persistent references explicitly reopened for the current frame.

rho.description: Current-direction convergence allocation. Not correctness probability.

theta.description: Allocation outside the current direction; theta = 1 - rho. Not error probability.
